c1_bet.mechanical_verdict: does not replicate (CI includes 0 or opposite sign)

novel_subset.definition: max SequenceMatcher ratio vs any original message < 0.9 AND not an exact copy of the same episode's original message

notes: PRIMARY pooled CI = cluster bootstrap over the 306 contexts (orig_id), stratified by scheme (51 per scheme), 10k reps, RNG seed 0 (separate generator); each sampled context carries all 5 sets' outcomes.
OPTIMISTIC pooled CI (kept for reference) = episodes resampled independently within set x scheme strata; it treats the 5 sets' copies of a context as independent and understates uncertainty.

REPLICATES vocabulary is gated: only used when the original effect is >= 10 pp with a CI excluding 0; otherwise 'n/a (original effect < 10 pp)'. The mechanical rule outcome is reported in a separate column.
The n=5 seed-level SD is indicative only: a 95% CI for an SD from 5 values is roughly [0.6, 2.9] x SD.
About 150 uncorrected tests are run across the project; all p-values and CIs here are descriptive (no multiplicity correction); do not interpret |delta| < 5 pp or p > 1e-3 as evidence on their own.
assumptions: Pooled bootstrap resamples episodes within set x scheme strata (30 strata of 51): sets are treated as fixed and episodes within a set as exchangeable. It does not treat the 5 sets as a random sample of sender seeds; seed-level variability is reported separately (SD/range of the 5 per-set Δ). The 5 sets share the same 306 episode contexts, so pooled episodes are not independent across sets.
